app.vector_editor_desc: Select the lines or shapes to remove before generating the 3D model. Selected parts are highlighted in red.
app.hollow_name_desc: The name has no fill, only walls
app.analysis_ok: No thin-line issues detected in this estimate.
app.big_letter_desc: Letter or text forming the main body
app.sunken_name_desc: Name placed inside the main letter
app.name_scale_desc: Size of the name relative to the main letter
app.name_offset_y_desc: Move the name up or down
app.bottom_cut_desc: Trim the bottom of the letter to create a flat support
app.warning_size: ⚠️ The model exceeds the build plate size!
app.upload_desc: Design that will serve as the base
app.upload_drag: Drag and drop your image here or click to browse
app.thickness_desc: Width of the main cutting line
app.base_desc: Finger support base and extra stability
app.printer_size_desc: Choose your printer to check if the model fits
app.contour_desc: Generates a cutter around the entire design
app.contour_offset_desc: Space between the design and the cutter edge
app.contour_height_desc: Height of the outer cutting wall
app.text_preview_placeholder: Choose a font below to see the preview
app.text_thickness_desc: Dilate or contract the text/design strokes
app.engraved_text_desc: Engrave the text into the base instead of extruding it outwards
app.keychain_width_desc: Plate width; length follows the text
app.ring_angle_desc: Angle (0 to 360) to place the keyring
app.text_content_desc: Separate with , for up to 9 keychains and use + for a second line. Emojis supported
app.tool_cookie_cutter_reference: Example of a 3D printed cookie cutter
app.tolerance_desc: Gap for the stamp to slide
app.thermoform_mold_height_desc: Height of the solid shape extrusion
app.thermoform_mold_base_desc: Thickness of the circular mold base
app.thermoform_mold_shape_desc: Elevation type of the positive mold
app.thermoform_mesh_height_desc: Height of the mesh frame piece
app.thermoform_mesh_outline_desc: Thickness of the outer contour wall
app.thermoform_enable_hanger_desc: Generate screw and loop system for hanging
app.thermoform_hanger_angle_desc: Angle of the thread position on the edge (0-360°)
app.thermoform_hanger_scale_desc: Adjust the proportional size of the hanging parts
app.stamp_size_desc: Maximum width of the final stamp
app.stamp_extrusion_desc: Depth of the design on top of the stamp (mm)
app.stamp_wall_thickness_desc: Total added thickness, distributed on both sides of the strokes (mm)
app.stamp_base_thickness_desc: Thickness of the base where the design sits
app.stamp_mirror_desc: Mirror the design (enable for stamps, disable for decorative use)
app.stamp_top_diameter_desc: Diameter of the stamp top, where the design is (mm)
app.top_thickness_desc: Height of the raised borders above the base
app.border_width_desc: Width of the raised contour lines
app.base_margin_desc: Extra margin around the design on the base plate

landing.how_subtitle: Three simple steps to create your custom 3D model.
landing.tool_brigadeiro_ejector_desc: Generate tall cutters and matching stamps for sweets.
landing.hero_subtitle: Transform images into 3D models ready for printing. Cookie cutters, keychains, stamps and more — all right in your browser.
landing.tools_subtitle: Choose a tool and start creating. New tools are added regularly.
landing.tool_cookie_desc: Parametric generator for cookie cutters, stamps and molds from any image or text.
landing.tool_keychain_desc: Create custom keychains with names, logos or unique shapes.
landing.tool_keychain_text_desc: Create custom keychains with personalized names and embossed text.
landing.tool_keychain_image_desc: Create custom keychains from any image or logo.
landing.tool_stamp_desc: Create custom 2-part stamps with interlocking system and adjustable relief.
landing.tool_thermoform_desc: Create mesh bases and positive molds ideal for the thermoforming technique using any image.
landing.tool_coloring_desc: Coloring pages with raised borders. Perfect for kids.
landing.tool_ejector_desc: Molds with ejector for brigadeiros and sweets. Produce hundreds in minutes.
landing.tool_letters_desc: 3D names and letters for parties, weddings and events.
landing.how_1_desc: Select the ideal generator for your project: cutters, keychains, stamps, etc.
landing.how_2_desc: Upload an image or write some text. Adjust sizes, thicknesses and shapes in real-time.
landing.how_3_desc: Download the STL or 3MF file ready to slice and send to your 3D printer.
landing.pricing_subtitle: Pay only for what you use. All new users receive 3 free exports.
